Make sure you vote in the upcoming General Election. Vote-by-Mail : the deadline to request is October 22, 2026 Early Voting : You can Vote Early, Monday, October 19 - Saturday, October 31, 8:30am-5:00pm in any of our five Early Voting Locations Election Day : Tuesday, November 3, 7:00am - 7:00pm, in your precinct - Find your Precinct Voter Registration If you would like to register to vote in Monroe County, or change or update your current registration, you can do that online here: or by downloading, completing and returning this registration form ( English or Español ). You can also come into one of our offices to get a form to complete in-office or at home. Click here for more information about registering to vote. If you would like to check the status of your registration or your Vote-by-Mail Ballot Request, CLICK HERE and enter the information as instructed. Request a Vote-by-Mail Ballot How to request a Vote-by-Mail ballot: Online via our Vote-by-Mail request tab Call us: Key West (305) 292-3416, Marathon (305) 289-6017, Key Largo (305) 453-8740 Mail or hand-deliver a Florida Statewide Vote-by-Mail request form: Florida Statewide Vote-by-Mail Ballot Request Form - English Formulario estatal para solicitar una boleta de voto por correo -  español Welcome We are happy to welcome all visitors to our website, especially those of you who are Monroe County voters. This site is primarily for you. If you have arrived here - at our new site - by entering our old site address or through an old bookmark, please update your bookmarks to reflect our new site address: www.votemonroeflkeys.gov Inside you'll find important information about our offices, how to register to vote , the voting process , and much more. You can also get more information about voting in Florida from the Florida Department of State - Division of Elections Website . Election Night Results November 3, 2026 - General Election Stay Tuned View Unofficial Results Monroe County Supervisor of Elections Important Information NOTICE OF CANVASSING BOARD MEETING NOTICE OF CANVASSING BOARD MEETING Please take notice that the Monroe County Canvassing Board will be convened on Sunday, October 18, 2026, at 12:15 pm, at the Supervisor of Elections Office at 5200 College Rd, Key West, Florida. The Board will be conducting logic and accuracy testing of additional equipment and any other matters that fall within the Board's purview. SHERRI HODIES SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS NOTICE OF CANVASSING BOARD MEETING Please take a notice that the Monroe County Canvassing Board will be convened on Sunday, October 18, 2026, at 8:00 am , at the Supervisor of Elections Office at 5200 College Rd, Key West, Florida. The Board will be conducting logic and accuracy testing of additional equipment and any other matters that fall within the Board's purview. SHERRI HODIES SUPERVISOR OF ELECTIONS Hours The Elections Office is open: Monday – Friday: 8:30am – 5:00pm Early Voting : Monday, October 19 - Saturday, October 31, 2026 8:30am - 5:00pm Vote-by-Mail Ballots can be hand-delivered inside each of our three offices (or to one the Secure Ballot Intake Station (drop box) located at each of our Early Voting locations during the Early Voting period: 10/19 - 10/31/2026). Your Vote-by-Mail ballot must be received by, but not later than, 7:00pm on Election Day.
